itineraries.title: Five days on the Budva riviera
itineraries.intro: Sveti Stefan, Budva and the bay beyond.

days.note: Board at Porto Montenegro; the naval heritage museum and the waterfront.
The new marina on the peninsula and the coves towards Cape Arza.
The old town on its peninsula and the beaches south to Sveti Stefan.
The island hotel from the water.
Bar; disembark or return to Tivat.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Dubrovnik to Budva
itineraries.intro: Dubrovnik, the Bay of Kotor and the Budva riviera.

days.note: Board beneath the walls; walk them in the evening once the day visitors have gone.
A quiet peninsula town south of Dubrovnik, with the Račić mausoleum above it.
The town at the mouth of the bay and its fortresses; a swim at Žanjice.
The baroque town and Our Lady of the Rocks on its man-made islet.
The walled town at the head of the bay; climb to the fortress for the view.
The new marina on the peninsula and the coves towards Cape Arza.
